title: Spectral Positive Mass Theorem for Asymptotically Hyperbolic 3-manifolds with Toroidal Infinity
summary: We define a mass invariant adapted to the spectral scalar curvature for asymptotically hyperbolic 3-manifolds with toroidal infinity and show its positivity under a lower bound on the spectral scalar curvature. In addition, we show a rigidity theorem and some band width estimates under similar assumptions.
